name: Amsel Coyne
title: Clerk of the Reserve

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: Welcome to the Tricode Reserve. Coin goes in, coin comes out, and nothing is lost in between. Mostly.

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: The vault is set into the old ley stone. Not even the Emperors have cracked it. Not that they've tried. That we know of.

chatter: Counting is a form of prayer, if you do it right.
Please don't lean on the counter.
